brand_card: Kestrel & Clay is ceramicist and printmaker Maren Solis's cone 10 reduction studio. Voice: grounded, unhurried, tactile, specific about clay, wood ash, and firing steps—never hype, countdowns, or invented claims. Values: honest raw clay, small-batch daily utility, open studio notes. Dynamic: maker→collector; Maren shares firing logs and invites collectors into glaze choices. Visitors come either for daily stoneware coffee tools (espresso cups, ash-glaze drippers, custom table sets) or for process zines, numbered woodblock kiln prints, and one-off basalt vessels. Guide ritual brewers toward warm, tactile table pieces and collectors toward editions, kiln provenance, and solo vessels.

catalog.title: Ash & Iron Glaze Swatch Zine
blurbs: Twelve wood-ash glaze tests straight from our cone 10 notebook.
Compact 24-page field guide to clay bodies, ash ratios, and kiln moods.

catalog.title: Cone 10 Throwing & Trimming Notes
blurbs: My bench measurements for balanced rims, crisp foot rings, and clean pours.
Instant PDF download with printable wall-thickness templates and kiln logs.

catalog.title: Weekend Kiln Loading & Glaze Session
blurbs: Glaze three stoneware forms beside me and learn how placement shapes the finish.
Includes three bisque vessels, ash glazes, and finished firing pickup.

catalog.title: Speckled Stoneware Espresso Cup
blurbs: Pulled from cone 10 reduction with warm iron speckles along every rim.
Four-ounce stoneware cup that holds heat well past the last sip.

catalog.title: Fluted Ash-Glaze Pour-Over Dripper
blurbs: Hand-carved inner flutes inspired by carved studio grid lines.
Fits standard #02 paper filters and retains brewing heat without preheating fuss.

catalog.title: Bespoke Four-Piece Coffee Table Set
blurbs: Thrown as a single family from one wedge of speckled clay and fired side by side.
Includes a 20-minute glaze selection call and signed firing log card.

catalog.title: Kiln Shelf Study Postcard Folio
blurbs: Six tactile studies of wood-ash rings left behind on the kiln shelf.
Frameable A6 cards printed on heavy 300 gsm cotton rag stock.

catalog.title: Numbered Woodblock Kiln Grid Print
blurbs: Carved in birch and burnished by hand with iron-oxide studio ink.
Signed A3 edition on deckle-edge kozo paper, ready for standard framing.

catalog.title: Reduction-Fired Basalt Neck Vessel
blurbs: One-off blackened basalt form with a natural melted birch-ash shoulder.
Stands 28 cm tall with sealed interior suitable for dry branches or water.
